historical_wiring: DocumentService owns the live Core and workspace projection
evidence_label: publishes a candidate only after the transaction record fsyncs
rationale: The standalone Runtime is the only live Core and publishes projection, read-model, and search generations together.

historical_wiring: DocumentService projection events fan out to renderer consumers
current_owner: Outline Runtime watch plus renderer accepted deltas
evidence_label: maps exact Runtime Event changes onto the existing delta reducer contract
rationale: Accepted local deltas and authenticated Runtime Events replace main-process renderer echo routing without skipping revisions.

historical_wiring: DocumentService maintains long-lived sparse reads and text search
evidence_label: uses Runtime-ranked search and keeps sparse Node reads fresh in input order
rationale: The read model and index now live beside the authoritative Core and publish at one revision.

historical_wiring: Transient search receives persisted personal access ranking
evidence_label: synchronizes personal access ranking into Runtime and restores it after reconnect
rationale: The cutover retained ranking code but initially omitted the desktop-to-Runtime state sync.

historical_wiring: Human Node access updates and projection pruning reach Runtime ranking
evidence_label: keeps recovered desktop production wiring attached to the Runtime service
rationale: Main now forwards replace, upsert, and remove updates instead of leaving the Runtime ranker disconnected.

historical_wiring: Memory observes committed document projection changes
current_owner: Runtime projection Event observer in main
evidence_label: reconciles Runtime projection events without full graph scans
rationale: Memory consumes immutable sparse Runtime updates; observer failures are contained and reported by main.

historical_wiring: Ordinary document mutations and Memory publication share one write gate
evidence_label: plans Memory publication after earlier document mutations have updated the projection
rationale: The cutover kept only the Memory-local mutex; planning and commit are again linearized after already-admitted document mutations.

historical_wiring: Memory owns a second mutation authorization and projection filter
evidence_label: Memory mutation authorization as a second Outliner permission model
rationale: The private permission/filter model was deliberately retired; Runtime validation, causation, and protected definitions are authoritative.

historical_wiring: Memory deterministic definitions are protected from ordinary mutation
evidence_label: protects deterministic Memory tags while permitting ordinary tag application
rationale: The fixed tag IDs survived the cutover but their mutation protection initially did not.

historical_wiring: Workspace saver reports background persistence failure
current_owner: OutlineDocumentService durability monitor plus main diagnostic handler
evidence_label: reports a background Runtime durability failure without delaying the accepted edit
rationale: Accepted edits remain responsive while failures beyond the durable frontier are surfaced.

historical_wiring: Workspace saver coalesces idle writes and forces a maximum dirty age
evidence_label: coalesces sustained accepted edits at the maximum dirty age under one fsync
rationale: The cutover initially fsynced every accepted edit; idle and maximum-age coalescing are restored.

historical_wiring: Import Pack API and tenon-import writer mutate the document
current_owner: Public outline Skill, CLI, adapter, and ChangeSet
evidence_label: Import Pack mutation APIs and the `tenon-import` writer
rationale: The private writer was deliberately retired; normalized import planning and one atomic public ChangeSet retain the user workflow.

historical_wiring: AssetService owns bytes, metadata, serving, and physical delete
evidence_label: persists immutable logical metadata with verified bytes across Runtime restart
rationale: Runtime AssetRecords and shared exact bytes replace the main-process asset store; physical delete is intentionally not public.

historical_wiring: Quit freezes admission and drains every admitted mutation
evidence_label: rechecks the barrier when a revision is accepted during drain
rationale: Quit closes local admission, waits admitted callers, installs the Runtime barrier, and drains the resulting frontier before teardown.

historical_wiring: Startup initializes projection, Memory, ranking, and Runtime ownership
evidence_label: lets simultaneous desktop and CLI supervisors attach to one standalone instance
rationale: One authenticated Runtime owns the workspace while desktop and CLI supervisors attach or replace stale development instances deterministically.

historical_wiring: Packaged and source entrypoints expose the same import and Runtime behavior
current_owner: Shared outline launcher and source adapter
evidence_label: runs packaged CLI, Runtime, and source adapter bundles through one launcher
rationale: Development, packaged, and adapter paths execute the same public capability surface.

historical_wiring: Renderer IPC can invoke arbitrary document commands and path asset operations
current_owner: Narrow preload bridge and desktop Runtime routes
evidence_label: restricts lifecycle control to desktop and freezes every Runtime mutation origin
rationale: Renderer mutations use admitted desktop ChangeSets; private lifecycle, path ingest, export, status, and log routes remain outside the generic renderer surface.
